claim: You can use Amazon EventBridge to detect and react to changes in the status of AWS Config events: EventBridge rules invoke target actions when an event matches the values you specify.
question: How do you trigger an automated action when an AWS Config event changes state?

values.display: invokes one or more target actions

evidence.quote: Amazon EventBridge delivers a near real-time stream of system events that describe changes in AWS resources. Use Amazon EventBridge to detect and react to changes in the status of AWS Config events.
Then, based on rules you create, Amazon EventBridge invokes one or more target actions when an event matches the values you specify in a rule.
